annotations.title: One address, month by month in vaults

description: One address month by month across vaults: for each calendar month and vault, the balance at the start and end, deposits and withdrawals, and the result in dollars and percent (modified Dietz), with why a result is missing. Balances are read from 24 Sep 2026 and flows name their address from 5 Nov 2026; a result only where both balances were read and every flow into the vault that month names its address. Quote the coverage with the figures. FREE.
